This is an [R Markdown](http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com) Notebook. When you execute code within the notebook, the results appear beneath the code. 

Try executing this chunk by clicking the *Run* button within the chunk or by placing your cursor inside it and pressing *Ctrl+Shift+Enter*. 

```{r}
library(readr)
nys_acs <- read_csv("data/nys_acs.csv")
nys_schools <- read_csv("data/nys_schools.csv")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
schools_clean <- nys_schools |> distinct() |>
  mutate(county_name = na_if(county_name, "-99"),
         across(where(is.numeric), ~na_if(.x,-99)),
         per_free_lunch = if_else(per_free_lunch >1, NA_real_, per_free_lunch),
         per_reduced_lunch = if_else(per_reduced_lunch >1, NA_real_, per_reduced_lunch)
         )
```


```{r}
acs_clean <- nys_acs |> distinct() |>
   mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~na_if(.x,-99)))
```


```{r}
write.csv(schools_clean,"processed data/schools_clean.csv")
write.csv(acs_clean,"processed data/acs_clean.csv")
```


```{r}
LIQR <- quantile(nys_acs$median_household_income, probs = c(0.25))
UIQR <- quantile(nys_acs$median_household_income, probs = c(0.75))

acs_clean2 <- acs_clean |> 
  mutate(poverty_group = if_else(median_household_income > UIQR, "high",
                            if_else(median_household_income < LIQR, "low","medium")))

schools_clean2 <- schools_clean |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(math_z = scale(mean_math_score),
         ELA_z = scale(mean_ela_score))
```

```{r}
write.csv(schools_clean2,"processed data/schools_clean2.csv")
write.csv(acs_clean2,"processed data/acs_clean2.csv")
```


```{r}
merged_data <- schools_clean2 |> left_join(acs_clean2, by = c("county_name", "year"))

```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(merged_data) + geom_point(aes(x = per_free_lunch, y = math_z, color = region))

ggplot(merged_data) + geom_col(aes(x = poverty_group, y = math_z, color = poverty_group))

```
